channel_pair.title: Link {name}
channel_pair.note: Hermes pairs this profile's agent with a phone. Nothing is picked for you: choose, then scan the code.
channel_pair.scan_hint: On the phone that has the WhatsApp account, open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, and scan this code. If that is this phone, open this page in Core Hub on another screen (an iPad or a second phone) and scan it there.
channel_pair.personal_warning: Warning: if this is your personal number, everyone who messages it receives the agent’s pairing reply. Choose “Me (Message yourself)” instead.
channel_pair.done: Linked. The agent answers on it after its next restart.
channel_pair.done_as: Linked as {account}. The agent answers on it after its next restart.
channel_pair.done_now: Linked. The agent answers on it now; the first person to message it waits for your approval here.
channel_pair.done_as_now: Linked as {account}. The agent answers on it now; the first person to message it waits for your approval here.
channel_pair.done_self_now: Linked. Open “Message yourself” in WhatsApp on your phone and write to the agent.
channel_pair.done_as_self_now: Linked as {account}. Open “Message yourself” in WhatsApp on your phone and write to the agent.
